deltas.why: `hidden` is a global HTML attribute; a chip carrying it would not render at all. Rename only — the state is unchanged.
`id` is the host element's own HTML id. A screen reaching for its card by id would overwrite the record's citation number with a DOM handle, and print it on the record. Rename only.

note: 0.4.0 is the live-component receipt (qwts/quorum#38): VoteChip `ballot`→`choice` plus `pending`, PhaseStepper `failureKind`, ProposalCard frozen-roster props, DecisionCard `reason`/`challengeRefs` — all already implemented here — plus the 2026-07-28 rulings on qwts/quorum#19: Q6 ballot copy follows D6, and Q10 `hidden` is ballot secrecy only (`ProposalOption.hidden` removed upstream; this library's proposal-card already conceals the tally, never the label).
